text: Ate well at lunch, comfortable and in good spirits. No chest pain, no fever.
Seems confused this evening and refused dinner. Feels hot and is breathing fast.
expected: confusion, poor intake, fever, breathlessness -> raise one level

text: He is complaining of chest pain and sweating.
Slipped in the bathroom this morning, now says he feels dizzy.
Has not passed urine since morning and looks very sleepy.
expected: reduced urine output, drowsiness -> raise one level

text: He fell asleep after watching TV, slept well.
expected: no concerns ('fell asleep' is not a fall)
